posts.title: Giving Tuesday — a day when you're supposed to help the needy — is just around the corner
posts.description: Jeff Ayoub, of The Night Ministry, talks to a man sleeping on Lower Wacker Drive in 2016 Did you have a nice Thanksgiving? Eat a lot of turkey, stuffing, cranberry sauce, pumpkin pie? Of course you did. Everybody does. But did you pause to wonder why you and everybody else ate all that? Probably not.
